title: Royal birthdays of Hibernia
summary: How the four Irish kingdoms honor their rulers.

claims.text: Each of Hibernia's four great kingdoms celebrates its ruler's birthday: Leinster holds a grand ball and bardic festival for King Bran on July 22; Munster marks Queen Nuala's day, September 22, with poetry, chimerical sculpture contests and a feast.

Connaught, ruled by machine-loving King Fiachra, holds a mechanics' fair of inventions, gadgets and train rides on May 6; on November 20 all sworn to King Finn gather to pledge loyalty and drink to Finn's health.
